# Duke Ellington — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Duke Ellington known for?", "Mood Indigo"),
    ("What field did Duke Ellington work in?", "Jazz"),

    ("What is field?", "Jazz"),
    ("What is known for?", "Mood Indigo"),
    ("What is note?", "Beyond category; 3,000 compositions"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
